evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: YOTO draws direct answers until a probe-weighted vote settles; only an unsettled problem receives a single thought, which a failure head on the hidden state monitors and stops as soon as it predicts failure, handing the problem back to direct answers.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: At a matched 20k-token budget, YOTO is up to 5.9 points more accurate than the strongest early-exit baseline, using one failure-head threshold across model sizes.
